claims.statement: The current program requires beneficiaries to submit up to three payment applications through GWD and prepare supporting documents; final settlement under the new program also requires an energy-performance certificate.

The program remains active at material scale: official statistics through 4 September 2026 report 78,005 applications, 60,248 agreements and PLN 949.0 million paid under the edition launched on 31 March 2025.

Program rules and document requirements remain changeable: amendments effective 20 July 2026 changed eligibility, subsidy limits, implementation deadlines and who may certify specified completed works.

The Ministry reports that regional discussions addressed errors in submitted applications and documents, cost qualification and processing delays, supporting the existence of document-quality friction while not quantifying the defect rate attributable to installers.

Published commercial offers imply some willingness to pay for application and settlement assistance: observed prices include PLN 500 for settlement, PLN 200 per payment application scope, and comprehensive success-fee arrangements. These are seller offers, not verified purchases or conversion data.

Direct substitutes already cover the proposed workflow: consultants sell online payment-application preparation, installers bundle application service free with equipment purchases, energy specialists bundle settlement into audit-and-certificate packages, and public operators support eligible beneficiaries through final settlement.

Where the desk processes personal data on an installer's or other controller's behalf, GDPR Article 28 provides a contractible route but requires a binding processor agreement, documented instructions, sufficient safeguards and controls over subprocessors.

No signed referral arrangement, channel conversion rate, customer-acquisition cost observation or evidence that accountants, auditors or unrelated installers will distribute the service was provided or found.

No completed-case measurements establish analyst time, reviewer wage, OCR and storage expense, correction and liability cost, realized price, gross margin, CAC, payback period or monthly overhead; the proposed fully loaded economics remain unvalidated assumptions.

There is no evidence of a signed installer service contract, data-processing agreement, beneficiary authorization, exclusivity, fixed duration, transferability or enforceable right to receive case files; the stated family access is informal, at will and nonexclusive.
No permissioned case corpus, measured recurring defect taxonomy, exclusive training data, learning curve or demonstrated improvement in turnaround or accuracy establishes the proposed data moat.

Because several providers already assemble, check or settle Czyste Powietrze documentation, the checklist-and-review mechanism appears replicable rather than presently proprietary; differentiation would have to be demonstrated through execution, integrations, contracts or superior measured outcomes.

The exact boundary between clerical document QA and activities requiring an authorized energy professional, formal representation or other credentials has not been established for the proposed operating procedure, nor has professional-liability coverage been quoted.

No buyer interviews, paid pilot, invoice, renewal, repeat-case history, urgency measurement or evidence that installers rather than beneficiaries will pay PLN 500-1,200 per pack was provided or found.

contrary_evidence: RDotacje advertises payment-application preparation for PLN 200 per work scope, materially below the candidate's proposed PLN 500-1,200 price and therefore contradicting an assumption of broadly defensible pricing without measured differentiation.

Kotły Patrzyk advertises full application handling at no charge to customers buying installed heating equipment, demonstrating that an installer incumbent can bundle the administrative service into its core sale.

The Ministry states that public operators guide eligible lower-income beneficiaries through the entire process to final settlement; this government-supported substitute can reduce the addressable paid segment.
Termodiagnostyka bundles grant settlement free with an audit, application and certificate package, showing that credentialed energy-service incumbents can absorb closeout into a broader offer.
Official amendments in July 2026 changed deadlines, subsidy limits and certification rules, confirming that regulatory change can obsolete checklists and impose continuing maintenance costs.

unknowns: Whether any installer or beneficiary will purchase the proposed standalone closeout pack at the target price.
Observed paid conversion, repeat rate, case frequency per installer and contract renewal behavior.
Signed access, referral, processing, confidentiality, liability and beneficiary-authorization instruments.
Defect frequency and severity in permissioned real packs, including the fraction that the service can prevent.
Fully loaded labor, rework, specialist, software, security, insurance, support, sales and overhead cost per case.
Customer-acquisition cost and payback for installer, auditor, accountant and direct-beneficiary channels.
Whether the founder can lawfully and insurably perform every promised task without regulated credentials or formal authority.
Accuracy, false-negative rate and liability exposure of OCR or AI-assisted review.
Whether a proprietary, permissioned dataset can be retained and reused under customer contracts and data-protection rules.
Whether workflow automation produces a durable advantage before consultants, installers, auditors, public operators or program software replicate it.
